nom: Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester Citrus Brightening Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe sensitive skin consistently report the cleanser doesn't irritate or dry out their skin, several calling it the only cleanser that doesn't aggravate their sensitivity.
segments.dry: The reviewers who describe dry skin say the cleanser leaves their skin refreshed and hydrated rather than dry, even those who otherwise tend toward dryness and fine lines.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser controls oil and shine without stripping or drying their skin, several noting smaller-looking pores in oily areas with continued use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently say the cleanser balances oily areas without drying out the rest of their face, several calling it the first cleanser that works for both at once.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s through 60s consistently report brighter, more toned, or younger-looking skin with continued use, including several who say friends or family specifically noticed the difference in their skin.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers credit continued use with a collagen-boosting, firmer look and being told they look years younger, though one longtime user following a full multi-step Perricone routine says she has still developed new forehead wrinkles over time.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across oily, dry, combination, and sensitive skin, say the cleanser does not dry out or tighten their skin and even leaves it hydrated; however, several reviewers report the opposite — skin left dry, tight, or peeling, in a few cases so severely that it burned or peeled for weeks.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with a hormonal acne flare says her face was red and blotchy and felt like it was on fire before use, and was calm and no longer red the next morning after just one wash.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers say regular use evened their skin tone and faded dark spots or sun damage, including one who saw noticeable improvement in longstanding sun damage on her cheeks and forehead within about a week.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention acne-prone skin report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, in some cases within just a few days, but two reviewers report the opposite: persistent, worsening breakouts across the whole month they tried it.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report less midday shine and a better oil balance with continued use, several specifically noting no more shiny forehead by the afternoon.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a long way

extraits.titre: Broke out and dried out skin
extraits.texte: I gave this a good month try. I broke out terribly and continued to the whole month, even my fiancé noticed a difference in my skin. Once I stopped and started using the face wash I used before this, my skin instantly looked better. Also, it left me with such a dry feeling afterwards. This definitely didn't work for me and I'll be giving to somebody else or tossing.

Bought this on sale and it was my first Perricone purchase. I had heard really good things about the products, so really disappointed the cleanser makes my skin feel SO dry! I liked the deep clean it gave, so I tried to mix it with a more moisturizing cleanser I had, but it still left my face really, really dry. Was hoping to like, and find a routine with some of the other brightening or firming products.

The only downside to this product is that it does not effectively remove water-proof/water-resistant makeup (not that I need it to do so, that's what makeup remover is for!). Honestly, I am completely willing to overlook that fact given how amazing it is. As someone who is prone to spots/acne, this cleanser has definitely helped tremendously with my problem skin (something I noticed after using this product for only 2 weeks!). As an added benefit, my previously combination skin has now become normal (and gets alot less greasy throughout the day).

I trade off on my daily cleanser-I use this Citrus Wash and then use the Nutritive Cleanser. (Because I have issues that both address!) I've found that if you use a daily cleanser you truly do see cumulative effects-hence the title "Daily Cleanser"? ;-) I had humongous pores on my nose and chin when I first started using the a Citrus Wash along with pretty severe sun damage on my cheeks and forehead . At first I only used it when I saw my pores looking 'bad', but after a week of using it every day I noticed that they had quit looking 'bad'! That was enough to convince me! Then my niece came to visit and took one look at me exclaiming, " Aunt! Your face looks so marvelous! What have you been doing! I want it!" Need I say more?

extraits.titre: Best Cleanser I have ever used.
extraits.texte: I use it morning and evening. Before this cleanser, I hadn't used a cleanser in the am for several years, just warm water, because other cleansers were too drying to use twice per day. NOT the case with Citrus Fascial Wash. It cleanses thoroughly, removing make-up and grime, without drying out my skin. I have sensitive and moderately oily skin. Don't be discouraged by the size, it's a concentrated cleanser. One small pump is enough to cleanse face and neck. There isn't anything I don't like about this product.

Before using this product my face felt irritated and my mild hormonal acne made my cheek area feel as though it was on fire. Instantly when i used this product, my face felt cool and less irritated. The next morning my face was no longer red and blotchy. Best part, my acne flare up was gone. This product help me get rid of all the irritation that my face was experiencing. My face glows! I'm definitely investing in more of Dr. Perricone's products.

I have been using N.V.Perricone products for 10 years. This is my favorite cleanser, as it shrinks my large pores, and balances my oily/combination skin, (even though I am in my early 50's).Dr.Perricone cleansers are the only ones that don't dry out or aggravate my very, sensitive skin, (I am a fair skinned, red head).I use this cleanser twice a day.
